headline: Powell Industries Gears Up to Report Q3 Earnings: What's in the Cards?
summary: POWL heads into Q3 earnings with expectations for double-digit growth, supported by a strong backlog and demand across utility and energy markets.

headline: Ingersoll Rand (IR) Stock Looks Pricey As Cash Flow Leaves Little Upside
summary: Ingersoll Rand stock has delivered a 75.1% return over the past 5 years, yet the current checks suggest it no longer looks obviously cheap, with the intrinsic value estimate from a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model sitting close to the market price while earnings based multiples lean expensive. A 75.1% gain over 5 years points to a stock that has already rewarded long term holders and may now offer a more modest margin for new investors. Future cash flow growth and margin execution can...
